item.title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes Batch Job Management: Queue Systems, Operators & Orchestrators
item.description: Kubernetes Jobs are designed for batch workloads — finite tasks that run to completion and terminate. But when you’re running hundreds of batch jobs per day for ML training, data processing, or CI/CD pipelines, the native Job controller becomes a bottleneck. You need queueing, priority management, gang scheduling (all-or-nothing scheduling for multi-pod jobs), and fair resource sharing across teams.
